failureClass: Unobserved or falsely accepted Alchemy Preview desired-state and live-state drift
acceptedMechanism: One Preview-only native Alchemy desired plan plus Sync.plan dry-run uses a Schema-decoded unique set of separately revocable Vercel credentials project-scoped to exact manifest projects, with assigned-project success and sibling-project denial proved before custody; it rejects team-wide project and storage resolution, observes exact manifest projects and Marketplace attachment hints from project environment metadata, decodes non-empty Vercel custom deployment targets but excludes them from Bundjil Preview and Production observations, reports accepted historical deployment identities that are absent from the current Vercel list without claiming no-op, deletion, retention or repair authority, accepts an ObservedUnknown write-only baseline when native sync is unchanged with present provider revision metadata or when a no-op desired plan accompanies a drifted row whose exact current provider update timestamp is bound by the accepted two-read manifest, materialises the Schema-encoded accepted manifest from its exact gzip/base64 GitHub transport into mode-0600 custody, and is classified through an Effect Schema report bound to branded repository/run/attempt identity, source SHA, static authority fingerprint and decoded manifest digest, wrapped by the fixed bounded receipt, and published only as a report-only GitHub run/check disposition. A missing or different admitted provider timestamp remains inconclusive. The external Marketplace database ID is retained from the accepted manifest only after the observable project, integration, configuration and resource tuple matches; it is not current provider readback. Write-only baseline acceptance proves metadata continuity only, never the value.
signal: Pull request for main, the exact weekly schedule, or one manual read-only dispatch.
durableState: The branded repository/run/attempt identity, exact source SHA, static authority fingerprint, decoded manifest digest, fingerprint-only classified report and bounded receipt for that run.
authority: docs/operations/authority-register.json#github-infrastructure-drift and the workflow-bound static read-only authority policy; dynamic execution identity is derived separately from trusted GitHub context.
convergence: One current report per source/ref; newer work cancels stale work; no-op requires zero desired-plan changes and accepted native-sync observations, while unavailable historical deployment observations remain explicit report findings.
proofPerRun: The executable Bun report command must produce a non-empty Schema-valid bounded receipt that is read back in the hosted log and names repository/run/attempt identity, source SHA, stage, static authority fingerprint, decoded manifest digest, desired-plan counts, classified per-resource findings, provider-writes:0 and command disposition; exact-project Marketplace hints prove attachment but do not prove the retained external database ID, and the GitHub run/check remains a separate external readback.
boundedFailure: Twenty-minute job timeout, exact repository/fork gate, Preview-only stage, three exact secret artifacts, separately revocable project-scoped Vercel bindings with exact project routing and sibling-denial proof and no team-wide project or storage fallback, fail-closed missing/duplicate/unmatched custody, fixed secret-safe pre-receipt failure phases, nonzero failed or inconclusive status, inconclusive unknown revision when any accepted-baseline precondition is absent, and no provider or state repair edge.
repairRoute: No automatic repair. A human opens the target-owned Alchemy runbook, obtains exact apply authority, re-reads state, repairs one accepted property and proves convergence.
falsePositiveCost: One read-only provider run plus human review of a fingerprint-only finding; no provider or state write.
carryingCost: One weekly read-only run plus same-repository pull-request runs, bounded hosted duration and review attention.
reviewTrigger: Alchemy version, state shape, provider read contract, secret binding, workflow trigger, stage, classification, false positive, cost, missing run, or alert-owner change.
stopAndRollback: Stop on widened permission, Production target, missing or ambiguous readback, secret leak, unexpected plan class, provider write, stale run, or missing receipt. Revert the workflow source or separately disable/revoke its read-only environment and credentials.
retirementCondition: Retire if the signal no longer detects actionable drift, carrying cost exceeds accepted value, or a smaller earlier provider-owned control proves the same postcondition.
disconfirmingEvidence: A green repository suite without a native provider read does not prove no drift.
Bun help text with exit zero and no receipt is a false green, not a hosted drift result.
A successful command or run without classified resource postconditions does not prove convergence.
A matching project Marketplace attachment hint does not prove the retained external database ID is current.
An unavailable historical deployment report does not prove that the deployment still exists or was deleted.
Unchanged provider revision metadata and an accepted ObservedUnknown baseline do not prove the write-only secret value.
A current report does not prove a future run, alert delivery, provider availability, or repair.
remindersToRetire: Remove provisional drift scheduling prose once the executable workflow, typed registers and runbook are current.
